description: This file defines a custom web component called 'common-home' which extends a WebComponent class and sets its inner HTML using a loader template. It appears to be part of the UI layer for the 'common/home' feature in an OpenCart-based frontend.

classes.name: CommonHome
classes.description: A custom web component class extending WebComponent, responsible for rendering the 'common/home' section.

methods.name: connected()
methods.description: An asynchronous lifecycle method called when the component is connected to the DOM; it sets the innerHTML of the component using a template.
